mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "O" names the common point of the rays that form an angle. Right image: The symbol "O" names the common point of the rays that form an angle.
Rationales: The left occurrence is O at the left endpoint of the two rays enclosing the small arc. The right occurrence is O where the horizontal line and oblique rays meet. The placement in each image shows that the symbol names the common point of the rays that form an angle.
